Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We pulled the team together and want to lock the target swap week and get the final sizing attested on your side. A couple quick asks:

- Can you confirm the "usable GPU" number you expect us to sign off on (we showed 28xA100 in the draft)?
- Do you need a separate NVMe validation run before the rehearsal?
- Target swap week from our side is the week of Dec 20 (procurement is finalizing on Friday). If that moves, what is the latest acceptable date to keep the agreed SLA?

I've attached the Lumina sizing sheet (v3) with our QPS and sample traffic profile. Please review and confirm.

Thanks,
Alex Chen

Subject: Re: Hosted->Dedicated: sizing follow-up & target swap week

Alex — thanks for the sheet and the follow-up. High level responses below; internal ops notes are cc'd.

- Usable GPU: based on the traffic profile you provided (95th p90 token distribution, bursts to 1.2k QPS), we recommend sizing for 24 usable A100 units with a 20% safety buffer (effective commitment = 30 A100). That gives headroom for autoscaling and KV cache priming without impacting tail latency.

- NVMe validation: yes — we require an NVMe performance rehearsal (30–60 min) to validate checkpoint load and model cold-starts. We'll run a short stress harness that mirrors your prefix distributions.

- Swap week: week of Dec 20 is OK if procurement signs by EOD Dec 18. If not, the fallback window to retain SLA without extra credits is Jan 3–7.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the final QPS and any expected spike days (blackouts or demos).
2) Grant our team access to the sizing sheet (I added comments).
3) We will schedule an internal pre-rehearsal (ops-only) on Dec 19 to validate NVMe and routing.

I attached a short rehearsal runbook draft.

- Aditya
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: swap-rehearsal-runbook.pdf)

Subject: Internal: Lumina rehearsal / sizing attestation checklist

Team —

Quick internal coordination before we lock times with Lumina. Key acceptance criteria and asks for the operations run (NVMe + KV cache):

Acceptance criteria (must pass all to sign off):
- Throughput: sustained 95th-percentile token throughput within 10% of their preflight profile for 45 minutes.
- Latency: p95 inference latency ≤ 220ms for standard prompts; tail p99 not > 2x baseline.
- Warm cache behavior: KV hit-rate ≥ 78% after 20 minutes of warmup.
- Fallback: successful fallback to hosted model variant under simulated capacity pressure with < 30s error spike window.

Operational items:
- Reserve 36 A100 nodes in staging (24 usable + 20% safety) — Karthik can you confirm node availability?
- NVMe validation harness: Jordan to run the checkpoint load test and verify < 90s cold-start median.
- Telemetry: enable per-route traces for Lumina routes and hold retention at 30 days for post-rehearsal analysis.
- Runbook: review the attached and surface any missing rollback steps.

Tentative schedule:
- 2026-12-19 09:00 PST — Ops-only NVMe + checkpoint rehearsal (no external traffic)
- 2026-12-20 10:00 PST — Customer-facing rehearsal (dry-run, controlled traffic)
- 2026-12-21 08:00–12:00 PST — Cutover maintenance window (if Lumina needs shift to 12/21)

If procurement pushes to the 21st, we'll push the customer rehearsal to the 21st morning and keep the 21st afternoon as the final swap window. Please reply with availability.

- Aditya
(Attachment: swap-rehearsal-runbook.pdf)

Subject: Re: Lumina - final sizing attestation and swap rehearsal cadence

Alex — thanks for the update and for completing the sizing sheet. We can accommodate the Dec 21 rehearsal + same-day cutover with the following firm commitments and safeguards:

Final attestation (Redwood):
- Committed usable capacity: 24 A100 (effective fleet reserved: 30 units to include 20% safety buffer).
- Burst policy during rehearsal: we will allow a controlled burst to an additional 6 units for up to 60 minutes for demo-day spikes (billing follows standard burst-overage terms; we will put a cap and notify procurement).
- NVMe validation: passed in ops-only run on 12/19. Checkpoint loads median cold-start = 82s. KV warmup target exceeded (81% after 20 min).

Cutover timeline (Dec 21, PST):
- 07:00 — Ops-on-call sync & final telemetry checks (Slack call + phone bridge).
- 08:00–09:00 — Customer-facing rehearsal (controlled traffic, spike sim).
- 09:00–11:00 — Analysis & decision window (must meet acceptance criteria listed below).
- 11:30–12:30 — Planned swap (DNS + routing change, model pinning).
- 12:30–13:30 — Smoke validation (p50/p95 checks + KV hit-rate).
- 13:30–15:30 — Fallback hold window (if rollback needed) / monitor for 2 hours.

Acceptance criteria to proceed with swap (must be green in analysis window):
- Sustained throughput within 10% of profile for 30 min.
- p95 latency ≤ 220ms and p99 not exceeding 2x baseline.
- Successful fallback test completes within 3 minutes if initiated.

Rollback triggers (one-pager summary):
- p95 latency > 350ms for > 15 minutes.
- Error rate > 2% sustained for > 5 minutes.
- KV hit-rate < 60% after 30 minutes of warmup.

Logistics & docs:
- DocuSign MOU for dedicated capacity sent (docusign_dedicated_mou_20261220.pdf).
- Rehearsal runbook: https://app.redwood.com/ops/runbooks/LUM-4921-rehearsal
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1G1-example (sizing sheet + logs)

Point-of-contact during window:
- Aditya Rao (phone: +1-415-555-0123) — overall lead
- Neha Kapoor — telemetry & traces
- Karthik Iyer — GPU fleet ops

If Lumina confirms the morning rehearsal we will lock the runbook and send the final SRE checklist.

Thanks — talk soon.

- Aditya
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
